mapper.select: select snapshot_id from abr_source_snapshot where source_url = #{sourceUrl} and content_hash = #{contentHash}
mapper.insert: insert into abr_source_snapshot (source_url, final_url, source_kind, http_status, content_type, content_hash, content, content_size, title, first_seen_time, last_seen_time, seen_count, fetched_by, remark) values (#{sourceUrl}, coalesce(#{finalUrl}, ''), #{sourceKind}, #{httpStatus}, coalesce(#{contentType}, ''), #{contentHash}, #{content}, #{contentSize}, coalesce(#{title}, ''), now(), now(), 1, coalesce(#{fetchedBy}, ''), #{remark}) on conflict (source_url, content_hash) do update set last_seen_time = now(), seen_count = abr_source_snapshot.seen_count + 1
mapper.update: update abr_source_snapshot set last_seen_time = now(), seen_count = seen_count + 1, final_url = coalesce(#{finalUrl}, final_url), http_status = coalesce(#{httpStatus}, http_status) where snapshot_id = #{snapshotId}
mapper.select: select snapshot_id, source_url, final_url, source_kind, http_status, content_type, content_hash, content, content_size, title, first_seen_time, last_seen_time, seen_count, fetched_by, remark from abr_source_snapshot where source_url = #{sourceUrl} and last_seen_time >= #{since} order by last_seen_time desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into abr_field_history (table_name, record_id, field_name, old_value, new_value, snapshot_id, source_url, quote, change_mode, status, operator, create_time) values (#{tableName}, #{recordId}, #{fieldName}, #{oldValue}, #{newValue}, #{snapshotId}, coalesce(#{sourceUrl}, ''), coalesce(#{quote}, ''), #{changeMode}, 'applied', coalesce(#{operator}, ''), now())
mapper.sql: select h.history_id, h.table_name, h.record_id, h.field_name, h.old_value, h.new_value, h.snapshot_id, exists (select 1 from abr_source_snapshot s where s.snapshot_id = h.snapshot_id) as snapshot_available, h.source_url, h.quote, h.change_mode, h.status, h.operator, h.create_time from abr_field_history h
mapper.select: where h.table_name = #{tableName} and h.record_id = #{recordId} order by h.history_id desc
mapper.update: update abr_field_history set status = 'rolled_back' where history_id = #{historyId} and status = 'applied'
